meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: solution_aTFrQkQDgvp7m17er_playbook_an9qh
title: Update CASE Metrics (Automated)
description: >
  Automatically tracks and updates CASE metrics when status changes, capturing timestamps for key status transitions and logging updates to the timeline.
actions:
  Create_Metrics_Payload:
    title: Create Metrics Payload
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Calculates and constructs metric timestamps based on status transitions (Escalated, Blocked, Closed) and initial evidence timing for the CASE record.
    on-success:
    - Metrics_Payload_Exists: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      metrics_payload:
        title: Metrics Payload
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: >-
            (
                $current := event.data.record.values ;
                $previous := event.data.previous.values ;

                $current_status := $current.status ;
                $previous_status := $previous.status ;

                $current_first_created := $current.`first-created` ;
                $current_time_of_first_evidence := $current.`time-of-first-evidence` ;
                $current_time_escalated := $current.`time_escalated` ;
                $current_time_blocked := $current.`time_blocked` ;
                $current_time_closed := $current.`time_closed` ;
                $current_time_assigned := $current.`time-assigned`;


                $new_time_of_first_evidence := $exists($current_time_of_first_evidence) ? {} : {'time-of-first-evidence': $current_first_created} ;
                $new_time_escalated := $current_status = "Escalated" and $not($exists($current_time_escalated)) ? {'time-escalated': $now()} : {} ;
                $new_time_blocked := $current_status = "Blocked" and $not($exists($current_time_blocked)) ? {'time-blocked': $now()} : {} ;
                $new_time_assigned := $current_status = "Closed" and $not($exists($current_time_assigned)) ? {'time-assigned': $now()} : {} ;
                $new_time_closed := $current_status = "Closed" and $not($exists($current_time_closed)) ? {'time-closed': $now()} : {} ;


                $result := $merge([$new_time_of_first_evidence, $new_time_escalated, $new_time_closed, $new_time_blocked, $new_time_assigned]) ;

            )
          data:
            event:
              data:
                record:
                  values:
                    $:ref: $event.data.record.values
                previous:
                  values:
                    $:ref: $event.data.previous.values
        actionType: jsonata
        next: metrics_payload_exists
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        testInputs:
          data: {}
          expression: ""
      metrics_payload_exists:
        title: Metrics Payload Exists
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: '($count($keys(actions.Create_Metrics_Payload.result.metrics_payload)) > 0 ? true : false)'
          data:
            actions:
              Create_Metrics_Payload:
                result:
                  metrics_payload:
                    $:ref: $actions.Create_Metrics_Payload.result.metrics_payload
        actionType: jsonata
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        next: ""
        testInputs:
          data: {}
          expression: ""
    entrypoint: metrics_payload
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    errorSchemaReferenceId: ecc28eb2-1f2c-4dc8-93e4-a7614df57b9c
  Update_SIG_Record:
    title: Update SIG Record
    type: recordAction
    description: >
      Applies calculated metric timestamps to the CASE record, updating fields like time-escalated, time-blocked, time-closed, and time-of-first-evidence.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      patchValues:
        $:ref: $actions.Create_Metrics_Payload.result.metrics_payload
      restrictions:
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
      applicationName: ""
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
    recordActionType: patch
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Metrics_Payload_Exists:
    title: Metrics Payload Exists
    type: conditional
    description: >
      Evaluates whether the metrics payload contains any updates to determine if record modification is necessary.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    conditions:
    - action: Update_SIG_Record
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $actions.Create_Metrics_Payload.result.metrics_payload_exists
          - $:eq: true
    else: ""
    inputSchemaReferenceId: d4d53b26-26b1-4ef1-878c-dfcfaae139f4
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    disabled: false
triggers:
  records:
  - afngq:
      if:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values.status
          - $:neq: '{ $:ref: $event.data.previous.values.status }'
          - ignoreCase: false
entrypoints:
- Create_Metrics_Payload
meta:
  enabled: true
namespace: $default
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish: {}
environment: {}
inputs:
  type: object

Metrics_Payload_Exists.description: Evaluates whether the metrics payload contains any updates to determine if record modification is necessary.
